ValidationRule.description: Amounts must be nonnegative, add up to the total, and fuel amount must match the presence of liters.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Amounts must be nonnegative, add up to the total, and fuel amount must match the presence of liters.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(Total_Amount__c <= 0, Fuel_Amount__c < 0, Other_Amount__c < 0, Liters__c < 0, Fuel_Amount__c + Other_Amount__c <> Total_Amount__c, AND(Fuel_Amount__c > 0, Liters__c <= 0), AND(Fuel_Amount__c = 0, Liters__c <> 0))
